summary: User-selected coordinator behavior requires an explicit opportunity pass at entry/resume and after delivery, changed blockers or the start of hosted waits. Compare eligible Deliveries by actual prerequisites, existing owners/PRs, touch-sets and shared outputs; disjoint source preparation, review or evidence collection may advance while another lane waits. Parent/sibling blocking does not automatically fence independent work. Worker slots do not establish resource capacity: selected operations require real remaining CPU/memory, integrator and hosted-CI capacity after active demand and known/Unknown reservations, preserving serial expensive-run limits and one integrator for shared surfaces. Delegate only when the runtime permits it and isolation/ownership and value justify coordination cost; preserve existing owner/attempt rather than duplicate a lane. If parallel work is unavailable, continue eligible serial work and identify the determining constraint and reopening condition. Do not split merely to fill slots, weaken acceptance or create reporting-only workers or another scheduling ledger. This extends the already delivered unfiltered intake triage requirement without changing protected enrollment, qualified caller/binding or native admission. The skill edit grants no runtime delegation where prohibited; source delivery is not installed fleet adoption.
title: Work-board actively seeks useful parallel work within actual remaining capacity
